## Why This Is Asked

This scenario tests advanced CDC ingestion patterns, including upserts, schema drift handling, backfill strategies, and metadata provenance with Purview.

## Key Concepts

- Change Data Capture (CDC) with SQL Server and Debezium
- Delta Lake upserts (MERGE) and schema evolution
- Watermarks and late-arriving data handling with backfill windows
- Purview lineage integration and metadata tagging
- Checkpointing and idempotent load patterns

## Code Example

```scala
// Spark Structured Streaming skeleton for CDC -> Bronze Delta
val df = spark.readStream
  .format("kafka")
  .option("kafka.bootstrap.servers", "broker:9092")
  .option("subscribe", "cdc_topic")
  .load()

val cdcDF = df.selectExpr("CAST(value AS STRING)")
  .select(from_json($"value", cdcSchema).as("data"))
  .select("data.*")

cdcDF.writeStream
  .format("delta")
  .option("checkpointLocation", "/mnt/delta/bronze/_checkpoints")
  .start("/mnt/delta/bronze/cdc_table")
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design multi-tenant data lakes with schema drift, governance, and cost controls in Azure.

## Key Concepts
- Multi-tenancy and per-tenant isolation
- Per-tenant schema inference and drift tolerance
- Delta Lake partitioning and late data handling
- Synapse Row-Level Security and Purview lineage
- SFTP + Event Hubs ingestion and Spark processing

## Code Example
```sql
MERGE INTO curated.transactions AS t
USING staging.transactions AS s
ON t.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.amount = s.amount, t.updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tenant_id, id, amount, updated_at) VALUES (s.tenant_id, s.id, s.amount, SYSUTCDATETIME());
```

```sql
CREATE SECURITY POLICY TenantFilter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE (tenant_id = SYSTEM_USER) ON curated.transactions
WITH (STATE = on);
```

- How would you tune partitioning for cost and performance across tenants?
